he sent an email this morning with q list of questions for you:

Hi Hrusikesh & Cydney,

I’ve nearly got my draft on next steps completed. I’m aiming to share with Alan and Michael today. Hopefully, we’ll have it to you soon. On the YouTube data extract, if this is close to being delivered then great. If it’s still on the stack, then for the moment it can wait.

I do have a few more questions.

1. TNM’s website – It looks like it’s not getting refreshed much. I’m guessing at the moment it isn’t your primary focus but will be once TNM’s app goes on-line. I was anticipating an in-house version of the TikTok and Instagram feeds, so I was surprised/pleased when I saw traditional long-form article content. What’s the plan for this type of content going forward? Is this one of the main motivators for TNM’s App?
1. The website has GA trackers on it. I don’t see a sign-on, so can I assume the only way to track visits between sessions via first party cookies?
1. What cloud vendor are you using. One of our recommendations will be to instantiate an analytics capability through which ever cloud vendor you have selected.
Hrusikesh if you could give me quick one-word answers to 2 and 3 today that would be really helpful to me. Cydney happy for your thoughts on point 1, really I’m just looking for confirmation that TNM’s app is going to be a consolidator of video, short form and long form content with full customer level tracking.

Many thanks,

Jaan.

messages.text:
Moving us to one chat to close these loops -

1. `Phone number` in onboarding – We want account creation to be Google SSO or Phone Number + Password. Hrusi is flagging that phone number might be PII and we need to make sure we are compliant with how to handle this information

Once the aurora migration is completed this evening, we will have to submit another version of the app for approval since it is technically a new build. Alternatively, we think the best option is to go ahead and release the build that was already approved today since it will be unlisted. We'll submit the aurora-migrated version next week, which should be approved before any creator posts go out given we aren't changing any features, and before we see an uptick in new users.
